newsitem.title: USA: Conseco to buy Pioneer Financial for $477 mln.
newsitem.headline: Conseco to buy Pioneer Financial for $477 mln.

text.p: Conseco Inc and Pioneer Financial Services Inc said Monday they agreed to merge, with Conseco acquiring Pioneer Financial in a deal valued at $477 million.

As part of the merger, each Pioneer Financial share will be converted into the right to receive a fraction of a share of Conseco stock having a value of between $25 and $28. The valuation will be based on the closing price of Conseco shares in the 10 trading days immediately preceding the second trading day prior to closing.
The companies said that Pioneer's outstanding convertible subordinated notes would be convertible into Conseco stock on an equivalent basis.
Included in the total value of the transaction is $417 million to purchase Pioneer's 16.7 million common shares and equivalents and $60 million to retire bank debt and pay other costs, they added.
Completion of the transaction, subject to approval by Pioneer stockholders and regulatory authorities, is expected within 180 days.
Pioneer Financial is a national health and life insurer.

"It's an excellent match, bringing together (Pioneer's) supplemental health and life insurance products and its 90,000 agents, and Conseco's products and 90,000 independent and career agents to create the largest distribution organization selling health and life insurance products in our selected markets," Conseco Chairman Stephen Hilbert said in a statement.
He added that Peter Nauert, who has been chairman of Pioneer since 1982, will continue with Conseco.
Hilbert said that Nauert will be instrumental in building profitable business at the Pioneer companies and working to maximize synergies during and after the transition.

"(Pioneer) brings a strong reputation and track record in marketing, product development and distribution of health and life insurance products, including the development of national networks of home health care and long-term care providers that should enhance sales in our senior market," Nauert said. "By combining (Pioneer's) marketing and distribution expertise with the Conseco organization, we can together become the leading company in each of our target markets."
PFS underwrites and markets health insurance, life insurance and annuities throughout the United States.

Conseco is a financial services organization, with subsidiaries that supplement health insurance, retirement annuities and universal life insurance. Upon completion of this and other pending transactions, Conseco said it will have $32 billion of investments under management, $29 billion of assets on its own balance sheet and $7.3 billion in annual premiums and revenues.
